disposition_summary: Under the currently recorded capacity assumptions and strict eligibility requirements, the candidate-corpus registry cannot supply the six-stratum Decision Rule B target (240 speakers/stratum = 1,440 total across 6 strata). Mozilla Common Voice 27 has 0 unexposed strictly eligible Irish speakers remaining. Edinburgh Accent Corpus (EdAcc) contains only 104 speakers worldwide across 40 accents (at most 3-4 Irish speakers). VoxCeleb lacks verbatim ground-truth transcripts and validated accent labels, rendering it methodologically inadmissible for confirmatory ASR evaluation under Protocol v1.4.0. Across all candidates, the maximum identifiable unexposed Irish pool is only 15 speakers (shortfall: 225 speakers). Furthermore, any uncrossed patchwork creates mathematically collinear corpus-by-accent confounding (Rank(X) < p), and downsampling to N_g <= 40 causes joint statistical power to drop below the mandatory 90% threshold.

design_confounding_analysis.mathematical_collinearity_explanation: Under fixed-effects linear model theory, the additive main-effects design matrix X_add has rank 10 of max 10 across 1 connected component(s). When c > 1 (DISCONNECTED_CONFOUNDED), accent contrasts across disjoint components are collinear with corpus differences (E[y_i - y_i'] = (alpha_i - alpha_i') + Delta_gamma). When K_obs (15) < I*J (30), interaction parameters (alpha*gamma)_ij for unobserved cells cannot be identified.

formal_recommendations: Do NOT proceed with Cohort 3 audio download or physical materialization under Decision Rule B.
Do NOT attempt confirmatory materialization from Common Voice 27 alone (Irish unexposed capacity = 0).
Do NOT adopt an uncrossed patchwork (e.g. Irish only from OpenSLR/EdAcc, Australia only from AusTalk), as accent and corpus effects become mathematically collinear and non-identifiable.
Do NOT ingest VoxCeleb without ground-truth verbatim transcripts and verified dialect tags.
Do NOT silently downsample to N_g <= 40, as joint power drops severely (violating the 90% threshold).

Evaluate Pathway 1 (5-Stratum Confirmatory Benchmark, N_g=220, Australian, Canadian, England, South Asian, US) via Project-Lead Academic Authorization, with Irish English treated as an exploratory case study.
